h1: Custom Gildan Apparel for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom Gildan apparel in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Ideal for teams, events, and uniforms. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Gildan apparel is a go-to choice for bulk orders because of its consistent sizing, durable construction, and wide range of styles from tees to hoodies. Whether you are outfitting a safety crew with high-visibility polos or branding hoodies for a company retreat, Gildan's cotton and cotton-blend fabrics hold up well to screen printing and embroidery. The Softstyle and Ultra Cotton lines offer different weights to match your climate and comfort needs.
heroAltText: Custom Gildan apparel including t-shirts and hoodies with company logo printed on front
